state_bank_of_india.name: State Bank of India
never_via_call: ask for UPI PIN or MPIN
ask for ATM PIN or debit card PIN
ask you to install any app
ask to transfer money to a safe account
legitimate_call_reasons: inform about credit card payment due
state_bank_of_india.kyc_policy: SBI conducts KYC only at the branch or via the YONO app. SBI never asks for OTP or any personal credentials over a phone call to complete KYC.

hdfc_bank.name: HDFC Bank
never_via_call: ask to install a remote access app
ask for Aadhaar or PAN details over phone
hdfc_bank.kyc_policy: HDFC Bank updates KYC only at the branch or via the HDFC Bank app. They never ask for OTP or passwords over the phone.

icici_bank.name: ICICI Bank
never_via_call: ask for debit or credit card PIN
ask you to share screen or grant remote access
icici_bank.kyc_policy: ICICI Bank performs KYC at the branch or via iMobile Pay. They never ask for credentials or OTP over phone.

axis_bank.name: Axis Bank
never_via_call: ask for full card number or CVV
ask to install any app for verification
axis_bank.kyc_policy: Axis Bank does KYC at branches or via Axis Mobile App. Never over the phone.

kotak_mahindra_bank.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
never_via_call: ask for UPI PIN or MPIN
ask for Aadhaar or PAN number
kotak_mahindra_bank.kyc_policy: Kotak Mahindra Bank never requests OTP, passwords, or card details over the phone.

punjab_national_bank.name: Punjab National Bank
never_via_call: ask for full card number or CVV
punjab_national_bank.kyc_policy: PNB never collects KYC information or banking credentials over the phone.

uidai_aadhaar.name: UIDAI (Aadhaar)
uidai_aadhaar.special_rule: UIDAI NEVER calls citizens for any reason. Any call claiming to be from UIDAI or Aadhaar is fraudulent.
never_via_call: ask for Aadhaar number over phone
ask for personal details to update Aadhaar
uidai_aadhaar.kyc_policy: UIDAI does not contact citizens via phone calls for any purpose. Aadhaar updates are done only at Aadhaar Seva Kendra or online at myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in.

income_tax_department.name: Income Tax Department
income_tax_department.special_rule: The Income Tax Department NEVER collects payments over the phone or asks for bank details via a call.
never_via_call: ask for bank account number over phone
ask for OTP to process a refund
ask for UPI payment for tax dues
legitimate_call_reasons: send SMS/email about pending notices (not phone calls)
income_tax_department.kyc_policy: The Income Tax Department communicates via the official income tax portal (incometax.gov.in). They never make unsolicited calls to collect payments.

trai.name: TRAI
trai.special_rule: TRAI NEVER calls consumers to block SIM cards or take action against them. TRAI only communicates via official channels with telecom operators.
never_via_call: block SIM cards via phone call instructions
ask consumers to press 9 to prevent disconnection
ask for payment to keep number active
threaten SIM disconnection to individual consumers
trai.kyc_policy: TRAI does not make direct calls to consumers. If your number is at risk, your telecom provider (Jio/Airtel etc.) will notify you, not TRAI.

rbi.name: Reserve Bank of India
rbi.special_rule: The RBI NEVER deals directly with the public regarding personal bank accounts. Any call from 'RBI' asking for personal or banking details is fraudulent.
never_via_call: contact individual citizens about their personal accounts
ask for OTP or banking credentials
help transfer money from foreign countries
ask for any fee or tax payment
conduct any KYC for personal accounts
rbi.kyc_policy: The RBI regulates banks and does not directly communicate with individual bank customers. For banking grievances, contact your bank or the RBI Banking Ombudsman portal.

law_enforcement_cbi_ed_police.name: Law Enforcement (CBI / Police / ED)
law_enforcement_cbi_ed_police.special_rule: Law enforcement agencies in India NEVER conduct arrests via phone or video call. 'Digital arrest' is NOT a real legal concept. Any such call is a scam.
never_via_call: ask for money transfer to a safe account
require victim to stay on video call as digital arrest
ask for OTP or bank details to clear your name
issue court orders over the phone
law_enforcement_cbi_ed_police.kyc_policy: Legitimate law enforcement serves legal notices in person or via official written communication. They never threaten arrest via phone or demand money.

paytm.name: Paytm
never_via_call: ask for Paytm PIN or MPIN
ask for card details or CVV
ask to install any app for verification
ask you to scan a QR code to receive money
legitimate_call_reasons: customer support callback (only if you raised a ticket)
paytm.kyc_policy: Paytm KYC is done via the app or at official Paytm KYC points. Paytm never asks for OTP or credentials over the phone.

phonepe.name: PhonePe
never_via_call: ask to scan a QR code to receive a refund
legitimate_call_reasons: callback if you raised a support ticket
phonepe.kyc_policy: PhonePe never asks for your UPI PIN, OTP, or any password over the phone.

amazon_india.name: Amazon India
never_via_call: ask for OTP to deliver a package
ask for payment to release a parcel
ask for card details over phone
claim a parcel contains illegal items
ask for Aadhaar details to process a return
demand customs duty payment via UPI
legitimate_call_reasons: customer support callback (if you raised a ticket)
amazon_india.kyc_policy: Amazon India never asks for OTP or payment to deliver a package. Delivery OTPs if used are only for contactless delivery verification at the door, not for payment.

jio.name: Jio
never_via_call: ask for OTP to prevent SIM block
ask for payment to reactivate number
ask for card details over phone
threaten immediate SIM disconnection unless you pay
ask you to press 9 to avoid disconnection
jio.kyc_policy: Jio communicates SIM-related issues via SMS or the MyJio app. They never threaten disconnection or ask for payment via an unsolicited phone call.

airtel.name: Airtel
never_via_call: ask for OTP to prevent SIM block
ask for payment via UPI to keep number active
threaten disconnection unless you pay immediately over phone
airtel.kyc_policy: Airtel communicates via SMS and the Airtel Thanks app. Unsolicited calls asking for payment or OTP are not from Airtel.
